question: What is the meaning of users in relation to ownership and users/actors?
description: Users in the context of ownership and actors refer to individuals or entities that interact with digital product passports (DPPs) in various capacities. They can be owners, contractors, producers/manufacturers/suppliers, or users, each with distinct roles and responsibilities. Owners may initiate construction projects, manage structures during their service life, or release structures at the end of their useful life. Contractors are responsible for designing, constructing, or refurbishing structures. Producers/manufacturers/suppliers provide specialized parts or materials, and users seek transparency or make changes to structures. Passport builders set up and manage the data format and ensure data availability and legibility. These roles are crucial for the effective functioning and traceability of DPPs in the construction sector.
